_metadata.description: miRNAs with known abundant 5'-isomiRs that could affect forward primer specificity in stem-loop RT-qPCR (Chen 2005). 5'-isomiRs arise from imprecise Drosha/Dicer cleavage at the 5' end of the pre-miRNA hairpin, shifting the start of the mature miRNA by ±1 or ±2 nt. Because the forward primer always spans the 5' end of the miRNA, it will co-amplify both the canonical form and any 5'-shifted isomiR.
_metadata.isomir_type: 5prime — shift of ±1 or ±2 nt at 5' end of mature miRNA

Morin08.citation: Morin RD et al. Application of massively parallel sequencing to microRNA profiling and discovery in human embryonic stem cells. Genome Research 2008;18(4):610-621.

Neilsen12.citation: Neilsen CT, Goodall GJ, Bracken CP. IsomiRs — the overlooked repertoire in the dynamic microRNAome. Trends in Genetics 2012;28(11):544-549. [NOTE: SPEC_phase3 incorrectly cites this as Bioinformatics; the journal is Trends in Genetics.]

Swierniak13.citation: Swierniak M et al. In-depth characterization of the microRNA transcriptome in normal thyroid and papillary thyroid carcinoma. J Clin Endocrinol Metab 2013;98(8):E1401-9.

evidence_levels.study_specific: Documented in ≥1 primary study that explicitly reported 5'-isomiR for this miRNA with sequence-level evidence and specific read counts.
evidence_levels.review_supported: Documented in multiple independent deep-sequencing datasets; cited in systematic reviews. No single primary study retrieved with PMID, but widely reproduced.

_metadata.flag_logic_note: The current check_isomir_flag() logic is: in_risk_window = (forward_3prime_position <= risk_window_nt). For typical specific_lengths (12-17 nt) and risk_window_nt (2-3), this condition is never True. The flag currently identifies miRNAs WHERE co-amplification risk exists, but the in_risk_window sub-check does not gate on primer length geometry. Interpret isomir_discrimination_risk=False as 'primer extends past the variable window', NOT as 'no co-amplification risk' for these listed miRNAs.

hsa-miR-21-5p.source: Neilsen CT et al. 2012 Trends Genet [PMID:22883467, DOI:10.1016/j.tig.2012.07.005]: one of the most cited examples of 5'-isomiR variability in the review. Documented across multiple independent deep-sequencing datasets in diverse human tissues. +1 isomiR begins at canonical position 2 (AGCUUAUCAGACUGAUGUUGA).

hsa-miR-122-5p.source: Neilsen CT et al. 2012 Trends Genet [PMID:22883467, DOI:10.1016/j.tig.2012.07.005]: liver-specific miRNA; 5'-isomiR variability documented in multiple deep-sequencing studies of liver tissue and serum. The +1 isomiR (GGAGUGUGACAAUGGUGUUUG) changes the seed sequence and is relevant in serum biomarker quantification.

hsa-miR-155-5p.source: Neilsen CT et al. 2012 Trends Genet [PMID:22883467, DOI:10.1016/j.tig.2012.07.005]: immune cell-enriched miRNA; 5'-isomiR variability documented across multiple immune cell deep-sequencing datasets. The +1 isomiR shift is particularly prevalent in activated lymphocytes.

hsa-miR-146a-5p.source: Neilsen CT et al. 2012 Trends Genet [PMID:22883467, DOI:10.1016/j.tig.2012.07.005]: NF-κB-regulated inflammation marker; 5'-isomiR variability documented in multiple immune and inflammatory context deep-sequencing datasets. +1 isomiR alters seed and predicted target spectrum.

hsa-miR-146b-5p.source: Swierniak M et al. 2013 J Clin Endocrinol Metab [PMID:23783103, DOI:10.1210/jc.2013-1214]: 'For highly deregulated miR-146b-5p, we detected 6 isoforms that varied at their 5' ends with a 1-nt difference that created 2 alternative seeds. The target genes for those 2 seeds overlapped in only 13.1% of genes.' Documented in both normal thyroid and papillary thyroid carcinoma (n=28 samples).

hsa-miR-126-3p.source: Neilsen CT et al. 2012 Trends Genet [PMID:22883467, DOI:10.1016/j.tig.2012.07.005]: vascular endothelial miRNA; 5'-isomiR variability reported in multiple vascular tissue sequencing datasets. Evidence is less abundant than for miR-10a or miR-146b; independent verification recommended.

hsa-miR-10a-5p.source: Morin RD et al. 2008 Genome Res [PMID:18285502, DOI:10.1101/gr.7179508]: among the first deep-sequencing studies to explicitly document 5'-end sequence heterogeneity at single-nucleotide resolution. miR-10a showed abundant reads mapping to ±1 and ±2 nt 5' offsets from the canonical start site, making it the canonical example of 5'-isomiR variability in the HOX cluster. Replicated in many subsequent studies.

hsa-miR-10b-5p.source: Morin RD et al. 2008 Genome Res [PMID:18285502, DOI:10.1101/gr.7179508]: miR-10b is processed from the same HOX cluster genomic locus class as miR-10a and exhibits the same ±1/±2 nt 5'-isomiR processing pattern. Both miR-10a and miR-10b have near-identical pre-miRNA hairpin structures, and the Drosha cleavage ambiguity at the 5' arm is shared. Differs from miR-10a at position 13 (C→G at UACCCUGUAGAA**C**CGAAUUUGUG).
